Message:
“Now, I can die as a human.”
After those words leave
her smiling lips,
she fades away,
leaving behind
a single white flower.

Wait. This wasn’t
what I wished for.

I just wanted...
more time...to be with...!

As I lay, sunken deep
into my bed, I found myself
stroking the flower.

At some point in time,
doing this became
a habit of mine.

Because, each time
I touch the flower,
her selfish, yet gentle smile
floats into my mind.

I’ll live as a human,
and die as a human.
That’s what
I’d decided to do, but...

...Hey, this flower
won’t ever go away, right?

Until the day I die,
it’ll always be by my...

Huh, what’s this?
One of the petals have
turned a little browner...
